categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Jiayuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, manufacturing, and sales of high-performance electrolytic copper foil products, including lithium battery copper foil and electronic circuit copper foil. The company also develops and sells high-performance precision copper wire and is involved in photovoltaic power generation, energy storage, and related new energy businesses. It operates multiple subsidiaries focusing on copper foil production, copper wire manufacturing, and new energy technology development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced electrolytic copper foil manufacturing technologies including ultra-thin and extremely thin copper foil production, additive technology, cathode roller grinding, copper dissolution, copper powder cleaning, precision slitting, wastewater treatment, and copper foil inspection technologies. It has developed proprietary additive technologies and holds numerous patents related to copper foil production processes. The production emphasizes automation, intelligent manufacturing, and strict quality control to ensure product consistency and performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly lithium-ion battery manufacturers, including leading companies in the new energy vehicle sector such as CATL and other prominent battery producers. The products serve downstream markets including new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, 3C digital electronics, printed circuit boards (PCB), and copper-clad laminates (CCL). The company maintains long-term stable cooperation with major domestic and international customers in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong (Meizhou), Fujian (Ningde), Jiangxi (Ganzhou), Shandong (Liaocheng), Hunan (Hengyang), and Shenzhen. It serves domestic markets extensively and is actively expanding into overseas markets including Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. The company also exports copper foil products internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiayuan Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the copper foil supply chain, focusing on the production of electrolytic copper foil and precision copper wire, which are key raw materials for downstream lithium-ion battery and electronics manufacturers. It also integrates upstream raw material procurement and downstream logistics and supply chain management through subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment focused on developing thinner, higher-strength, and higher-performance copper foil products, including ultra-thin lithium battery copper foil, high-frequency PCB copper foil, and specialized copper foils for solid-state batteries. It emphasizes collaboration with academic institutions and industry partners, patent development, and advancing intelligent manufacturing. The R&D strategy includes expanding into new materials, composite copper foils, and energy storage technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of high-performance electrolytic copper foil products and precision copper wire. The company also earns income from photovoltaic EPC projects and other new energy-related services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to large battery manufacturers and some distributors, with pricing linked to copper raw material costs plus processing fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiayuan Technology is positioned as a leading domestic high-performance lithium battery copper foil manufacturer, ranking among the top in production capacity and technology in China. It competes with other domestic and international copper foil producers, facing intensified competition due to industry capacity expansion and market entrants. The company maintains a competitive edge through technological innovation, product quality, and strategic partnerships with major battery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.52 billion, a 31.27% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 238.83 million due to market competition and cost pressures. Total assets reached RMB 13.04 billion, with net assets of RMB 6.90 billion. The company’s copper foil production capacity exceeded 110,000 tons annually, with production and sales volumes growing by over 15%. Despite profitability challenges, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiayuan Technology emphasizes its advanced technological capabilities, including proprietary additive and ultra-thin copper foil manufacturing technologies, to deliver high-quality, high-performance copper foil products tailored for demanding applications such as new energy vehicles and high-frequency electronics. The company’s products offer superior mechanical properties, consistency, and reliability, supporting customers’ needs for energy density, safety, and performance. Its integrated supply chain and strong customer relationships further differentiate it in the competitive market.
